name: CRBN 1X Power Series 16mm
description: The CRBN 1X Power Series is an elongated, thermoformed paddle built for players who want maximum reach and put-away power from the baseline. Its raw Toray T700 carbon fiber face grips the ball for heavy topspin drives and serves, and foam-injected perimeter walls enlarge the sweet spot and stabilize off-center hits. The 5.5 inch handle leaves room for two-handed backhands.

specifications.core: 16 mm polypropylene honeycomb with foam-injected edge walls

care_instructions: Clean the raw carbon face with a carbon-safe eraser or damp microfiber to restore grit; never use abrasive pads. Keep out of hot cars and store in the included cover.
